label: Bulb
depicts: Light bulb outline with a zigzag filament inside and a short screw base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a bulb with a visible zigzag filament inside the glass.
avoid_when: Do not use for the empty bulb when the center of the globe should stay blank.

label: Bulb
depicts: Light bulb outline with an empty round globe above a short screw base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a plain bulb outline with no filament marks inside the globe.
avoid_when: Do not use for the lit bulb when a zigzag filament should be visible inside.

label: Cactus
depicts: Tall cactus with one arm on each side above a flat ground line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tall desert cactus with two side arms on a ground line.
avoid_when: Do not use for the oval thorn cactus when the plant should not be enclosed by an outer ring.

label: Cactus
depicts: Oval cactus ring with side thorns and one centered tall leaf
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rounded cactus form with an outer ring and thorn marks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the tall desert cactus when separate side arms on a ground line should be visible.

label: Camcorder
depicts: Tilted video camera body with one side handle and one lower hanging cord
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tilted handheld camcorder body with a visible cord loop.
avoid_when: Do not use for the lens ring icon when the shape should stay circular instead of camera shaped.
